event.ev_battery_boom.description: Battery makers are buying up every tonne of lithium coming off the pile. Demand will run well above normal for about 180 days.
event.ev_battery_boom.name: EV battery demand surge
event.ev_construction_slump.description: Building work has stalled across the region, and no new footings are going in. Iron demand drops by nearly a third for about 240 days.
event.ev_construction_slump.name: Construction slump
event.ev_fuel_spike.description: Diesel costs have jumped across the district. Every operating mine pays about 30% more to run for 120 days.
event.ev_fuel_spike.name: Fuel price spike
event.ev_land_rush.description: Speculators are buying up claims across the district. New plot listings ask about 40% more for a year.
event.ev_land_rush.name: Land rush

tech.automation_1.description: Automated haulage keeps ore moving from the face without extra hands on shift. Cuts the daily running cost of every mine by 20%.
tech.automation_1.name: Mine Automation
tech.bulk_logistics.description: Rail sidings and covered stockpiles keep the weather off the pile. Storage costs drop by 40%.
tech.bulk_logistics.name: Bulk Logistics
tech.core_sampling.description: Pulling drill core puts real rock in the trays instead of guesswork. Survey error drops by 40% more.
tech.core_sampling.name: Core Sampling
tech.efficient_extraction_1.description: Simpler footings and a tighter site layout keep early spending lean. Cuts the cost of building a mine by 15%.
tech.efficient_extraction_1.name: Efficient Extraction I
tech.efficient_extraction_2.description: Standardised headframes and proven plant designs save the crew from custom fabrication. Cuts mine construction cost by a further 20%.
tech.efficient_extraction_2.name: Efficient Extraction II
tech.high_throughput_1.description: Heavier crushers break the ore down faster at the surface. Daily output across every mine is up 25%.
tech.high_throughput_1.name: High-Throughput Processing I
tech.high_throughput_2.description: A second processing line runs alongside the first. Daily output is up a further 30%.
tech.high_throughput_2.name: High-Throughput Processing II
tech.lithium_processing.description: A concentrator plant turns raw lithium ore into saleable concentrate. Without one in place, lithium cannot be mined or sold.
tech.lithium_processing.name: Lithium Processing
tech.program_stage_1.description: The engineering work for a launch site, needed before the first stage of the program can be completed.
tech.program_stage_1.name: Program stage one: launch site
tech.program_stage_2.description: The design of a launch vehicle, needed before the second stage of the program can be completed.
tech.program_stage_2.name: Program stage two: launch vehicle
tech.program_stage_3.description: The design of a deep-space payload, needed before the third stage of the program can be completed.
tech.program_stage_3.name: Program stage three: deep space payload
tech.seismic_survey_1.description: A proper seismic pass gives the crew a cleaner read on the ground. Cuts survey error by a fifth.
tech.seismic_survey_1.name: Seismic Survey I
tech.seismic_survey_2.description: Denser survey lines leave the crew with fewer blind spots underfoot. Cuts survey error by a further 30%.
tech.seismic_survey_2.name: Seismic Survey II

ui.how_to_1: The shift starts paused. Orders you file take effect when the next day runs, and the log notes whether they were accepted.
ui.how_to_2: 1. Survey a listed plot ({survey_cost}, {survey_days} days) to estimate deposits and place a sealed bid before the auction closes; 2. build a mine on owned ground over {days} days to haul ore daily; 3. sell ore from the Market tab when the price suits, before storage fees bite. 4. Fund research to improve surveys and mines; 5. stay solvent, since more than {months} month-ends in the red means bankruptcy.
ui.how_to_3: Cash is what sits in the safe; spendable is cash minus your standing bids. There is only one save slot, so New game and Load replace the current game without asking.
